brief:
Gaza's education system faces a critical need to compensate for widespread learning losses caused by three years of conflict, Shehab Wire reported. The war has severely damaged educational infrastructure across the territory, with the destruction of schools and educational institutions among the most visible impacts on civilian life.

Restoring educational capacity has become essential to preventing an entire generation from losing access to schooling. Officials view addressing the learning gap as crucial to the territory's long-term recovery and the future prospects of Gaza's youth.
dek: Gaza's education system faces a critical need to compensate for widespread learning losses caused by three years of conflict, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Gaza education sector seeks to address massive learning losses from three-year war
